name: Daily Gmail Summary Email
description: Summarize matching Gmail email snippets and send one HTML email with key points and named action items.
requirements: Gmail connection with read and compose/send permission; configure it for both collection Code nodes and the send Connector
Configure a Gmail search scope, one plain recipient address and optional CC addresses
Configure an available model on the Open Flow AI Agent or n8n OpenAI node; all collected snippets must fit its context
Review the daily 07:00 Asia/Kolkata schedule and the previous-local-midnight reporting window
